title: Bus-Only Lanes — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Painted or physically separated bus lanes let buses bypass congestion, improving speed and reliability. Enforcement cameras keep lanes clear where physical barriers are impractical. This overview edition presents Bus-Only Lanes as a core transit concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Design for frequency, speed, and reliability
Integrate fares and transfers across modes

real_examples.fact: Seoul and New York expanded bus-lane networks to speed commutes.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
